item.title: Missile alert sounded in United Arab Emirates for first time since ceasefire with Iran.
item.description: Authorities in the United Arab Emirates have issued a emergency missile alert urging residents to immediately seek shelter

item.title: Mali's junta leader takes over defense ministry after the minister was killed in militant attacks
item.description: Mali’s junta leader and the country's president has assumed the duties of defense minister after the incumbent was killed in sweeping, coordinated attacks by separatist and jihadi forces that stunned the country

item.title: Jews tell antisemitism inquiry of surge in hate before Bondi Hanukkah massacre
item.description: An Australian inquiry into antisemitism has heard from Jewish Australians who feel increasingly fearful after a massacre at a Hanukkah celebration
